note: Employer job boards polled by scripts/find-stages.mjs. Seeded from the boards already represented in stages.json, because an employer who took a student once will take another. Add a line to widen the search; nothing here is scraped — every entry is a documented public JSON API.
displayNamesNote: A board slug is not a company name. Without this the agent proposed 'togetherai' and 'BoschGroup', which is how the board ends up looking machine-filled. Add a line whenever a board is added.
